title: Obot Workshop: GitHub Auth, MCP, and Audit End-to-End
description: A complete Obot walkthrough: log in with the bootstrap token, set up GitHub authentication, add the GitHub MCP server to Claude Code, query your repositories, review the audit log, add a source catalog, install and enroll the Obot Sentry client, scan your inventory, automate scanning with hooks, forward a local MCP server's audit logs to Obot, and filter sensitive data with gateway filters.
